```sql
-- Query ABPerson table for address-related fields
SELECT FirstName || ' ' || LastName || ', ' || Address || ', ' || City || ', ' || State || ' ' || ZIP || ', ' || Country AS potential_address
FROM ABPerson
WHERE (Address REGEXP '(?i)\b(?:p\.?\s*o\.?\s*box|post\s+office\s+box|ave\.?|avenue|st\.?|street|rd\.?|road|blvd\.?|boulevard|dr\.?|drive|ln\.?|lane|ct\.?|court|pl\.?|place|way|pkwy\.?|parkway|cir\.?|circle|ter\.?|terrace|hwy\.?|highway|trl\.?|trail|sq\.?|square|pike|loop|run|walk|path|byp\.?|bypass|(?:n|s|e|w|ne|nw|se|sw)\b)\b'
   OR City REGEXP '(?i)\b(?:p\.?\s*o\.?\s*box|post\s+office\s+box|ave\.?|avenue|st\.?|street|rd\.?|road|blvd\.?|boulevard|dr\.?|drive|ln\.?|lane|ct\.?|court|pl\.?|place|way|pkwy\.?|parkway|cir\.?|circle|ter\.?|terrace|hwy\.?|highway|trl\.?|trail|sq\.?|square|pike|loop|run|walk|path|byp\.?|bypass|(?:n|s|e|w|ne|nw|se|sw)\b)\b'
   OR State REGEXP '(?i)\b(?:p\.?\s*o\.?\s*box|post\s+office\s+box|ave\.?|avenue|st\.?|street|rd\.?|road|blvd\.?|boulevard|dr\.?|drive|ln\.?|lane|ct\.?|court|pl\.?|place|way|pkwy\.?|parkway|cir\.?|circle|ter\.?|terrace|hwy\.?|highway|trl\.?|trail|sq\.?|square|pike|loop|run|walk|path|byp\.?|bypass|(?:n|s|e|w|ne|nw|se|sw)\b)\b'
   OR ZIP REGEXP '(?i)\b(?:p\.?\s*o\.?\s*box|post\s+office\s+box|ave\.?|avenue|st\.?|street|rd\.?|road|blvd\.?|boulevard|dr\.?|drive|ln\.?|lane|ct\.?|court|pl\.?|place|way|pkwy\.?|parkway|cir\.?|circle|ter\.?|terrace|hwy\.?|highway|trl\.?|trail|sq\.?|square|pike|loop|run|walk|path|byp\.?|bypass|(?:n|s|e|w|ne|nw|se|sw)\b)\b'
   OR Country REGEXP '(?i)\b(?:p\.?\s*o\.?\s*box|post\s+office\s+box|ave\.?|avenue|st\.?|street|rd\.?|road|blvd\.?|boulevard|dr\.?|drive|ln\.?|lane|ct\.?|court|pl\.?|place|way|pkwy\.?|parkway|cir\.?|circle|ter\.?|terrace|hwy\.?|highway|trl\.?|trail|sq\.?|square|pike|loop|run|walk|path|byp\.?|bypass|(?:n|s|e|w|ne|nw|se|sw)\b)\b')
   AND (Address IS NOT NULL OR City IS NOT NULL OR State IS NOT NULL OR ZIP IS NOT NULL OR Country IS NOT NULL)

UNION ALL

-- Query ABMultiValueEntry table for address-related fields
SELECT value AS potential_address
FROM ABMultiValueEntry
WHERE value REGEXP '(?i)\b(?:p\.?\s*o\.?\s*box|post\s+office\s+box|ave\.?|avenue|st\.?|street|rd\.?|road|blvd\.?|boulevard|dr\.?|drive|ln\.?|lane|ct\.?|court|pl\.?|place|way|pkwy\.?|parkway|cir\.?|circle|ter\.?|terrace|hwy\.?|highway|trl\.?|trail|sq\.?|square|pike|loop|run|walk|path|byp\.?|bypass|(?:n|s|e|w|ne|nw|se|sw)\b)\b'
   AND value IS NOT NULL;
```
